name: Toxic Voice Moderator
idea: Listens to in-game voice chat in real time and mutes or warns players for harassment and threats.
twist: Learns new Thai gamer slang weekly, so trash talk is allowed but threats and slurs are caught.
sources: Otorag (SK Telecom x Anthropic Claude Code Builder Hackathon 2025, Seoul, 1st place) — AI system that detects voice phishing in real time during phone calls using an LLM.

name: Live Claim Police
idea: Watches Shopee Live streams in real time and warns hosts the moment they make banned health or alcohol-ad claims.
twist: Updates its rule set when Thai FDA or alcohol-control rules change, and auto-mutes repeat violations.
sources: Comply AI (Stanford LLM x Law Hackathon Fall 2024, Best First Build, Stanford) — Uses reasoning agents to check videos and digital communications against region-specific regulations, cutting compliance review from weeks to hours.
PoliSights.ai (BU Spark! Civic Tech Hackathon 2025, Best Use of AI, Boston) — Uses NLP over regulatory documents to automate policy tracking and give small businesses real-time compliance insights.

name: Photo Theft Hunter
idea: Scans marketplaces for sellers using a shop's own product photos and files IP reports automatically.
twist: Catches cropped, re-coloured and watermark-removed copies of OTOP product photos, holding borderline cases for the owner.
sources: Warhol (Stanford CodeX LLM x Law Hackathon 2026 (FutureLaw Week), Harvey Challenge Award, Stanford) — Uses vision models to find visually similar images online and applies copyright law and case law to assess infringement risk.

name: ละคร Trend Autopilot
idea: Detects items trending from Thai dramas, creates matching bundles and adjusts stock across a seller's shop.
twist: Ramps down orders as soon as buzz fades after the finale, avoiding dead stock.
sources: DripSeek (SuperAI NEXT Hackathon 2025, Singapore, winner (one of four)) — Browser extension that identifies clothing worn by actors on streaming platforms in real time and lets users shop similar styles and try them on virtually.

name: SME Grant Hunter
idea: Monitors Thai SME grant and loan programs daily, matches them to the business and drafts applications.
twist: Re-checks eligibility when criteria or deadlines change and warns before the business misses a window.
sources: FundSight AI (Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Malaysia 2025, 3rd) — Financial data platform that matches SMEs to suitable grants and gives analytical insights for financial decisions.

name: ไลฟ์ Claim Guard
idea: Listens to a Shopee Live beauty or supplement stream and flags illegal health claims seconds after the host says them.
twist: Whispers a compliant Thai rephrase to the host's earpiece, catching phrases like 'หายขาด' before viewers hear them twice.
sources: Comply AI (Stanford LLM x Law Hackathon Fall 2024, Best First Build, Stanford) — Uses reasoning agents to check videos and digital communications against region-specific regulations, cutting compliance review from weeks to hours.

name: ละครช้อป
idea: Fans pause a Thai drama or BL series clip and instantly get the outfit or prop matched to Shopee listings.
twist: Ranks small Thai sellers above imports and builds 'wear what the actor wore' bundles from fandom screenshots.
sources: DripSeek (SuperAI NEXT Hackathon 2025, Singapore, winner (one of four)) — Browser extension that identifies clothing worn by actors on streaming platforms in real time and lets users shop similar styles and try them on virtually.

name: CF Catcher
idea: Turns 'CF' comments, LINE messages and transfer slips from Facebook Live sales into confirmed orders with ShopeePay links.
twist: Understands Thai CF slang like 'CF2 สีแดง' and resolves who claimed the last piece first across channels.
sources: RaoChatHub (Super AI Engineer Season 5 (AI Innovator Track) 2025, Thailand, 1st (Eastern center)) — Chatbot platform that answers from real databases and uploaded documents, reads images with vision AI, and unifies Facebook, Instagram and LINE messages; deployed for 24/7 student Q&A at Burapha University.

name: โทรสั่งได้
idea: A voice agent answers a small restaurant's phone, takes Thai orders and pushes them into the ShopeeFood kitchen queue.
twist: Handles Isan and Northern dialects and suggests dishes that use up ingredients before closing time.
sources: Pine AI (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 1st) — AI agent for customer service centres that handles natural voice conversations and automates support and sales workflows with personalised upsell suggestions.

name: No-Menu Bank Line
idea: MariBank's phone line drops the IVR menu; callers describe the problem and the agent resolves card freezes and slip disputes.
twist: Notices scam-pressure signals in an elder's voice and calmly pauses the transfer before finishing the request.
sources: Empathos (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 2nd) — Conversational assistant for telecom operators that replaces IVR menus so customers resolve issues on first contact.
WaiJai (AFTERKLASS Business KAMP 2025: Youth for Good (KBank), Thailand, 2nd) — AI platform that analyses scam risk across channels to protect elderly people and reassure their caregivers.

name: ประชุมหมู่บ้าน Minutes
idea: Records village meetings and turns them into decisions, owners and deadlines tracked until done.
twist: Transcribes regional dialects and writes the follow-up as a script for the village loudspeaker tower and LINE OpenChat.
sources: MeetMate (VNPT AI Hackathon 2025 (The Dreamer track), Vietnam, 3rd) — Meeting assistant that transcribes discussions in real time and generates summaries of decisions and action items.

name: Dropout Radar
idea: Combines attendance, grades and home-visit notes into a dropout risk score per student and suggests interventions.
twist: Fits Thai home-visit (เยี่ยมบ้าน) records and recommends specific equity-fund or scholarship routes to the homeroom teacher.
sources: Aegis (AI.DEAS for Impact 2025, Philippines, Champion + Most Promising Prototype) — AI health data platform that consolidates data into a vulnerability score for dengue risk in Cebu City barangays and recommends interventions.

name: Discharge Diet Ordering
idea: Reads a hospital discharge diet sheet and filters ShopeeFood menus so caregivers order safely for a recovering patient.
twist: Estimates sodium and potassium in Thai dishes like ส้มตำปลาร้า for kidney patients and asks the dietitian when unsure.
sources: Healthfood Advisory (Alibaba Cloud Indonesia GenAI Hackathon 2025 (with GoTo), Indonesia, 2nd) — AI assistant inside GoFood that recommends healthy meals based on a user's dietary preferences and health goals.

PostVisit.ai (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.6 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), 3rd place) — Explains medical diagnoses in plain language, analyzes visit notes and surfaces clinical evidence for patients between appointments.

name: มือสอง Grader
idea: Grades used phones from photos and settings screenshots for Shopee second-hand listings and detects suspicious evidence.
twist: Checks battery-health screenshots for editing, reads Thai repair stickers and prices by local มือสอง market rates.
sources: InsureScan (Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Malaysia 2025, 1st) — AI that analyses claim documents and images to detect vehicle damage and assess claim validity, speeding up insurance claims and resisting fraud.

name: ทุนหาเรา · grant matcher
idea: Matches a Shopee seller to Thai SME support schemes and drafts the application from real sales data.
twist: Uses shop performance and order history as evidence, so sellers without accountants can apply for support programmes.
sources: FundSight AI (Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Malaysia 2025, 3rd) — Financial data platform that matches SMEs to suitable grants and gives analytical insights for financial decisions.
